tree_title: Zerodha Coin First-Year SIP Retention Discovery Tree
framework: Teresa Torres Continuous Discovery Opportunity Solution Tree (First Diamond Only)
desired_outcome: First-time mutual fund investors stay invested past their first 12 months with uninterrupted monthly SIP installments

opportunity_areas.title: Mitigating Underwhelming Returns Shock (Months 1–3)
opportunity_areas.description: Users start SIP after seeing 15% CAGR compounding charts or social media reels. In months 1–3, portfolio returns fluctuate between -2% and +2%, leading users to feel SIP is a waste compared to 7% bank FDs.

sub_opportunities.title: Managing Day-30 First Statement Disillusionment
sub_opportunities.evidence: Users check first month statement expecting visible wealth generation; seeing ₹10 gain on ₹1,000 feels meaningless.

sub_opportunities.title: Addressing Nominal Flatness vs Fixed Deposit Comparison
sub_opportunities.evidence: Repeated verbatim mentions: 'Bank FD gives guaranteed 7%, why take risk in MF for 2%?'
sub_opportunities.addressability: Cognitive reframing of unit accumulation vs short-term valuation

opportunity_areas.title: Eliminating Silent Mandate Failures & Penalty Trauma (Months 1–6)
opportunity_areas.description: Auto-debit mandates (e-NACH/BSE StAR) trigger on dates when salary is delayed or account balance is low, triggering ₹250–₹590 bank bounce fees and silent cancellation after 3 misses.

sub_opportunities.title: Bridging Salary Credit Timing Variations
sub_opportunities.evidence: When salary credit slides from 1st to 5th of month, automatic debit fails with zero warning.
sub_opportunities.addressability: Dynamic debit scheduling and smart pre-debit notifications

sub_opportunities.title: Removing Bank Bounce Penalty Dread
sub_opportunities.evidence: Users furious after paying ₹295 penalty on a ₹500 SIP installment, leading them to cancel the mandate immediately.
sub_opportunities.addressability: Proactive balance pre-check and zero-penalty pause mechanisms

opportunity_areas.title: Demystifying Demat & Ledger Settlement Confusion (Months 1–12)
opportunity_areas.description: Zerodha Coin's Demat holding structure and BSE StAR routing creates a T+1/T+2 gap where bank funds are debited but units do not appear, making users fear their money was stolen or lost.

sub_opportunities.title: Resolving the T+2 Black Hole Anxiety
sub_opportunities.evidence: Repeated panic inquiries: 'Money debited from HDFC but Zerodha Coin shows ₹0 units and portfolio empty!'

sub_opportunities.title: Clarifying Coin SIP vs AMC SIP Discrepancies
sub_opportunities.evidence: Users trying to pause or modify amounts find AMC SIPs locked and un-editable.
sub_opportunities.addressability: Unifying mandate controls and clear in-app taxonomy

opportunity_areas.title: Overcoming Emotional Isolation During Market Drawdowns (Months 4–9)
opportunity_areas.description: During sideways markets or temporary corrections (-5%), the app shows red figures without explanation. Users receive no guidance, leading to loss aversion and panic cancellation.

sub_opportunities.title: Providing Contextual Reassurance During Red Portfolio Phases
sub_opportunities.evidence: Users open app, see red numbers, panic, and withdraw money to avoid losing capital.
sub_opportunities.addressability: Contextual market drawdown education and Rupee Cost Averaging visualizers

sub_opportunities.title: Combating App Inaction & Silence After Setup
sub_opportunities.evidence: Once SIP is set, app remains completely silent; users only receive transactional SMS from BSE/CDSL.
